name: Created Account Register Message
description: If a user tries to register with an email that already has an account, this shows a helpful message instead of an error.
project_description:
Instead of giving people who already have an account an error message when they attempt to register, this module gives a helpful message and (for admin-created accounts that were never used) sends a password-reset e-mail to welcome them.

 For example, a person whose account was created by an administrator, or who self-registered already but hasn't logged in yet, and who then tries to register at the site is now shown a message letting them know their account exists and that they have been sent an e-mail with a reset link: "You already have an account, we have e-mailed a password reset link in case you do not remember your password." A user who has logged in before instead sees a message with links to log in or reset their password.

 Without this module Drupal would trigger an unfriendly "This email is already in use" error. The module works entirely through a hook_form_alter on the core user registration form: there is no settings form, no permissions, and no configuration. This is especially useful when an administrator creates an account for someone and that person never uses the link sent by the admin, but still goes to register anyway.
